text:
Ruvenna Data Centre’s spring outage was caused by a failed cooling pump, according to an internal review released Monday by operator HelioGrid Systems. The breakdown hit the facility on April 18, taking 14 percent of customer racks offline for 3 hours and 22 minutes before engineers switched loads to a secondary loop. HelioGrid said the pump seized after a bearing defect triggered overheating in the main chiller line. No data was lost, but six clients logged service interruptions and one manufacturing analytics contract was paused for a day.

The company said it has replaced both primary pumps and added live thermal alerts. For the sector, the incident underscores how a single mechanical fault can still ripple through tightly packed colocation sites.
